_note: Vaulty greets each new Expeditioner once in #expeditioners-lobby: one random greeting + one random question for the lobby. {member} becomes a mention of the newcomer. Edit freely; the bot reads this file each time.
greetings: 📋 The Relocation Office stamps another file: **{member}** has signed up for Endros! Welcome aboard.
⚓ A new name on the passenger list: **{member}**. Welcome to Nowhere Expeditions!
🧭 **{member}** just walked into the Relocation Office, and nobody even had to bribe them. Welcome!
📦 Luggage tagged, paperwork filed: welcome, **{member}**! The Gates are glad to have you. Probably.
🌊 The ferry to Endros has one more passenger. Say hello to **{member}**!
🖋️ Ink still wet on the contract: **{member}** is officially an Expeditioner. Welcome!
🔭 Somewhere beyond the horizon, a Gate flickers in anticipation. Welcome, **{member}**!
🐄 Welcome, **{member}**! Please declare any cows, sheep or family members at the counter.
🗺️ Another cartographer of the unknown? Or a cook? Or a menace? Welcome, **{member}**, whoever you turn out to be!
🏗️ Endros grows by one. Welcome, **{member}**, and mind the floating platforms.
